name: Housecall Pro
summary: Home-service business software with estimates, scheduling, dispatch, invoicing and payments.
differentiator: Estimates are in every plan, including Basic ($59 per month billed annually, one user), but the sales proposal tool starts at Max ($299). Its own page says it is built for home-service trades such as HVAC, plumbing, electrical, cleaning and landscaping, and that it is available only in the US and Canada. Card processing starts at 2.59 percent.
pricing: Basic $59, Essentials $149 and Max $299 per month billed annually; $79, $189 and $329 on monthly billing. Included users are 1, 5 and 8, with additional Max users at $35 per month. A 14-day trial gives full Max access with no card. Month-to-month or annual, no long-term contract. Card processing fees start at 2.59 percent, with a 1 percent fee for bank payments.
category: Quoting and invoicing for small contractors
whoPays: Subscriber pays per plan; Max adds a fee per extra user
bestFor: Home-service trades that want estimates and dispatch in one tool and operate in the US or Canada.
skipIf: You bid commercial work through invitations, or work outside the US and Canada.
